name: Email Entry to Password Entry
summary: The user submits an email address for an existing password account and the server directs the client to the password-entry view.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and the submitted email belongs to an active password-enabled durable identity

inputs.name: Email
inputs.description: Email address for an existing password-enabled account.

serverInteraction.intent: Resolve the submitted email to the next supported authentication view.

postconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.continue.email.password is visible for the resolved identity
